apps.name: Last Wave
apps.subtitle: Your YouTube Music library, mixed like a DJ
apps.localizedDescription:
A native iPhone music player for your YouTube Music library, built in the style of Apple Music. Your playlists, likes and history come from your YouTube Music account; Last Wave adds DJ-style Automix with tempo matching, synced word-by-word lyrics, search by lyrics, offline downloads, Last.fm scrobbling and playlist import from Spotify and Apple Music.

Three interfaces: Classic (iOS 18), Liquid Glass (iOS 26) and Liquid Glass+ (iOS 27 and later). Requires iOS 18 or later and a YouTube Music account (free is fine).

Independent and non-commercial. Not affiliated with Google, YouTube, Spotify, Apple or Last.fm.

versions.localizedDescription:
Fixed the artist page: a hard dark band was covering the top of the artist's photo, caused by a new iOS 26+ system effect stacking on top of the page's own gradient. The header now shows the full photo cleanly behind the status bar and nav bar.

Build 25 · source c6f8a49 · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

An Apple design review and a SwiftUI code review pass: lyrics and queue text over animated covers are now legible, transport buttons have their full tap target, the mini player no longer clips at large text sizes, section headers without an action no longer look disabled, a Search bug that blocked tapping album results is fixed, low-contrast text on colored tiles is corrected, menu and toggle buttons meet the 44pt minimum, a playlist-delete timing issue is fixed, grammar and wording cleanups, and the full player no longer redraws ten times a second. Also: the app now builds under Swift 6's strict concurrency checking.

Build 24 · source 2828d18 · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

Arabic search answers in Arabic: searching المبدأ finds El Mabda2 instead of English "Principle" results. Arabic searches also look up the Arabizi spelling, so songs and artists named in Latin letters (Marwan Pablo, Wegz) are found, and translations are left out.

Build 23 · source 466b3f0 · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

Fixes a crash when closing the morph player with an animated cover. Animated covers in the morph player: reopening no longer jumps from the big cover to the small one, and closing shrinks the video into the mini player instead of a dark empty card. Search: suggestions and recent searches respond to taps again, and songs you play from Search are listed under the search bar.

Build 22 · source 21b42db · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

Playback fix: songs stopped playing from 1.0.11 on with "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot". That was a bug in Last Wave, not your network: YouTube's visitor id got longer and the app discarded it, so YouTube refused every request. Fixed. One song YouTube won't serve no longer stalls the whole queue. Two more backup sources for fetching a song that won't stream.

Build 21 · source 76cd4d2 · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

Fewer requests to YouTube, so its bot check is triggered less and lifts sooner: songs usually need one request instead of several, and one answer serves streaming, caching and quality changes. When YouTube does refuse the network, Last Wave stops asking for a while (one minute, then longer, up to ten), tries with a couple of requests instead of dozens, and tries at once when you switch between Wi-Fi and cellular or tap Try again in Settings › YouTube Music.

Build 20 · source 1b9fcd1 · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

Lyrics: word-synced lines now fill smoothly word by word as they are sung, with a soft edge and a gentle lift on the word in progress, like Apple Music. Right-to-left lyrics fill from the right. With Reduce Motion on, words fill without the lift.

Build 19 · source 93b23ac · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

Follow-ups from the external audit: the client table is checked at its pinned commit on every release, a slow first launch no longer switches proof-of-origin tokens off for the session, token minting backs off after a failure, sign-in is judged on the cookies the app keeps, copied-link offers can be switched off under Playback, and a few small hardening fixes. The app is now iPhone-only.

Build 18 · source 4f0e915 · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

Lyrics: seven more sources with Apple Music word-by-word timing; every source is asked at once and the best answer wins, fetched when you open the lyrics panel. Right-to-left lyrics lay out from the right. Search puts official artists and their recordings first, with a seal on official artists, and the keyboard can be put away without leaving the search. Animated covers: the large still steps aside for a small cover by the title. Proof-of-origin tokens are attached automatically to the clients YouTube asks, in a web view that never sees your sign-in. When YouTube refuses a network, the queue waits and Settings › YouTube Music › Access explains. Many hardening fixes from a full review.

Build 17 · source 12676b3 · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

PO tokens: the test token now mints. The challenge's program and global name were read from the wrong fields, which showed as "BotGuard script: VM not found". Nothing else changed since 1.0.8.

Build 16 · source b78c746 · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

Fixes from the first device run of 1.0.7: the opt-in player morph no longer crashes when opened with a swipe, dragging the lyrics scrolls them instead of closing the player, the closing panel is the bar's frosted material rather than black, and the cover never comes back blank. Animated covers work again (Apple changed its web token), and the PO token test no longer fails with a 400.

Build 15 · source 17f7a0d · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

Lyrics: seven more sources (SimpMusic, BetterLyrics, LyricsPlus, BiniLyrics, lrc.red, PaxSenix, Unison) with Apple Music word-by-word timing; every source is asked at once and the best answer wins. Try another source cycles through the sources that have lyrics and can be switched off. Opt-in: player morph from the mini player (Settings › Now Playing) and Apple Music animated covers (Beta). Stream clients can be updated remotely. Fixes: morph player sat under the status bar.

Build 14 · source db02e94 · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

## What's new in 1.0.6

- The player's heart now reflects songs you liked before, including older likes and likes made on another device: the app asks YouTube Music for the song's like state when it starts playing.
- Liked songs load as soon as the app is online, not only when the Library tab is opened.

Requires iOS 18 or later. Unsigned IPA; install with AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly or LiveContainer.

Build 13 · source 0c01370 · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

## What's new in 1.0.5

- Downloaded playlists stay complete: a song you add to a playlist you downloaded is downloaded too, and a song you remove leaves the playlist's Downloads card (the file stays in your downloads).
- Genre DNA is disabled offline, like the other pages that need a connection.

Requires iOS 18 or later. Unsigned IPA; install with AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly or LiveContainer.

Build 12 · source a1455ca · requires iOS 18.0 · SHA-256 in `LastWave.ipa.sha256`

## What's new in 1.0.4

- Cache Ahead now saves each song's cover next to its audio, so cached songs show their artwork offline.
- Offline mode is consistent across Home, Library, Search and the player: anything that needs a connection is greyed out, and songs that can't play offline are dimmed.
- Clearer messages: a failed request is now reported as such instead of "No results" or "Not found" across search, lyric search, mixes, Discover, Last.fm stats, playlists and imports.
- Start Mix plays the song on its own and says so when the mix can't be loaded.
- The Opus quality swap fades from the normalized volume and restores it when interrupted, so loud songs no longer jump in level.
- The list of YouTube clients the player can act as can be updated between releases (About › Stream clients), so a change on YouTube's side can be fixed without a new build.
- Many smaller fixes to playback, downloads and storage safety.

Requires iOS 18 or later. Unsigned IPA; install with AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly or LiveContainer.
